changelog: v1.4.0: Project NEXUS Phase 8 — Multi-Market Expansion. Crypto scanner grown 20 → 48 pairs across 9 sectors. New Alpaca connector adds US stocks (33 high-volume tickers) and commodity ETFs (GLD/SLV/USO/UNG/DBA/COPX). MarketWatchlist has asset-class tabs (Crypto / Stocks / Commodities) with a live market-hours badge. BrokerSettings now lists Alpaca alongside Binance/Zerodha. Deadline-Aware Strategy Router in goalExecutor: maps remaining time-to-deadline to scalp/day/swing/position buckets that pick markets, timeframe, and Kelly multiplier (less time = aggressive crypto scalp, more time = swing across all asset classes). Manifest + self-awareness updated so Jarvis knows about every new capability.
